book.neovitae.guide.altar.blood_altar.de: The central crafting station and its multiblock tiers.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.blood_altar.in:
The Blood Altar is the central crafting station of Neo Vitae. It converts Life Points into powerful items and serves as the foundation for increasingly complex multiblock structures.

Each tier unlocks new crafting recipes and increases the altar's capacity and power.
book.neovitae.guide.altar.blood_altar.ti: The base altar. Place it down and right-click with a Sacrificial Dagger to begin.
Surround the altar with 8 Blood Runes one block below. Any rune type works for the structure.
Add an outer ring of runes, four pillars of any solid block, and glowstone caps on each pillar.
Extend the pillars upward with Bloodstone caps. Add a larger outer ring of runes at a lower level.
The largest rune ring yet, with Hellforged Blocks at the four corners.
The ultimate altar. Four corner pillars topped with Crystal Clusters, and the largest rune ring spanning 23 blocks across.
